features.name: Document Chunking
features.description: IndexingService splits documents into ~500 char chunks at paragraph boundaries
features.evidence: IndexingService.chunkDocument packs paragraphs into <=500-char chunks and splits oversized paragraphs at sentence/word boundaries. Single-doc indexing now updates index-meta and the document's status/chunk count. Sample docs: design-notes 6 chunks (211-464 chars), meeting-summary 3, retrieval-plan 5. Delete removes chunks from index. npm run check passes.

features.name: Metadata Extraction
features.description: On import, extract word count, line count, and file type metadata from documents
features.evidence: DocumentService.importDocument calls extractMetadata (wordCount, lineCount, fileType) and rejects non-.txt/.md files and files >10MB. Samples: design-notes.md md/282 words/43 lines; meeting-summary.txt txt/163/20; retrieval-plan.md md/252/46; package.json rejected. Shown in DocumentDetail.

features.name: Indexing Status in StatusBar
features.description: StatusBar shows indexing progress with document counts and status indicator
features.evidence: getStatus now returns AppStatus (previously returned a mismatched shape) with indexedDocuments/documentsLoaded/totalChunks; StatusBar shows 'Indexed: X/N documents' with progress bar, chunk count, and colored status (idle -> ready after indexing all 3 samples, 14 chunks). Index All / Index Document buttons refresh status. App launches via electron without errors; UI not clicked through by automation.

features.name: Grounded Q&A with Citations
features.description: QaService returns answers with document citations and confidence scores
features.evidence: QaService ranks chunks by question-term overlap (stop words removed), returns up to 3 citations with sentence-level excerpts and an extractive answer built only from cited text; confidence 0.85 with citations, 0.30 without. 'How does retrieval rank chunks?' -> 3 citations from retrieval-plan/meeting-summary; nonsense question -> no citations, 0.30. Answer panel shows numbered citations and confidence.
